scenario: asking for help with neighbourhood & directions
english_title: Recognising and Responding to Asking for Help With Neighbourhood and Directions
vietnamese_title: Giao tiếp nền tảng: neighbourhood & directions — asking for help with neighbourhood & directions
primary_communication_goal: recognise and respond to asking for help with neighbourhood & directions; complete the exchange naturally at A0 / Pre-A1.
context_note_en: Ms Lan asks Mr James to help her find a bakery nearby.
context_note_vi: Chị Lan nhờ anh James giúp tìm tiệm bánh gần đây.

turns.speaker: Ms Lan
turns.english: Excuse me, James. Can you help me find a bakery nearby?
turns.vietnamese: Xin lỗi anh James. Anh giúp tôi tìm tiệm bánh gần đây được không?

turns.speaker: Mr James
turns.english: Yes, there is one on this street.
turns.vietnamese: Được chứ, có một tiệm trên phố này.
